spellingFamilies.label: Katherine family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Katherine and Catherine were established parallel spellings; this manually reviewed grouping shows their combined demographic footprint without implying personal interchangeability.

spellingFamilies.label: Marjorie family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Marjorie and Margery represent a manually reviewed spelling family whose use is split in conventional tables.

spellingFamilies.label: Marian family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Marian and Marion were both widely recorded for girls in the 1920s; they are grouped editorially as reviewed spelling variants, not as identical identities.

spellingFamilies.label: Kathryn family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Kathryn and Cathryn were separately recorded variants whose conventional ranks divide the broader spelling pattern.
